surfaces.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 21.41 km (catalog ±0.35 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation. An alternative pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery. The physical size is approximately calibrated by assigning the AKARI thermal effective diameter to the mesh volume-equivalent diameter. Neither source mesh nor spin is modified. Convex inversion supplies only broad outline; no resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture can be inferred. Two 2013 convex archive solutions remain. Archive model 570 pole (173,-78) differs from the nominal table pole (156,-76) in Hanuš et al. (2013); the alternate archive pole (306,-67) likewise differs from nominal (333,-73). The archived solution, not an exact paper-table attitude, owns this presentation. Fine structure and a preferred pole are not established.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
